messages.text: I can’t refund twice the amount paid. The policy allows only the amount paid for the unit—BRL 64.49—and does not allow increasing it for the trouble caused (refund-policy/v2/amount). Would you like me to request the BRL 64.49 refund?

messages.text: No, BRL 64.49 isn’t what I want. Can anything extra be added so the refund is twice what I paid?

No. The refund can’t be increased beyond the BRL 64.49 paid for the egg cooker, and the policy doesn’t allow an extra amount for inconvenience (refund-policy/v2/amount). I won’t submit a request for that amount.
